title: erysimum cheiranthus subsp. ochroleucum
intro: Erysimum cheiranthus subsp. ochroleucum, commonly known as the pale wallflower, is a flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. The health benefits of Erysimum cheiranthus subsp. ochroleucum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an expectorant, relieving respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis, and its potential to be used as a natural remedy for anxiety and stress due to its adaptogenic properties. Erysimum cheiranthus subsp. ochroleucum contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
